The hook additionally blocks any `kill`/signal on a background process and any `rm`/`mv` outside this session's own scratchpad dir, even for cleanup of clearly-disposable tmp files this session itself created (e.g. the rsync tree, a stray copy of findings.sarif accidentally written to the main checkout instead of the worktree).
